headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Run out of money: Hyderabadi Umrah pilgrims stranded in Saudi.
Maharashtra and Telangana to form joint panel on Tummidihatti Barrage.
Phase II reorganisation of Keralam’s State GST department under way.
Jordanian security forces arrest 3 men for deadly attack on church.
bullets_ur: Pese khatam hone par Hyderabadi Umrah zaireen Saudi Arabia mein phans gaye.

Keralam ke State GST department ki Phase II reorganisation ka amal jaari hai.
Jordanian security forces ne church par khaufnaak hamlay ke ilzam mein 3 afraad ko giraftar kar liya
